messages:
alicia: Quick sync — we need to finalize partner program scorecard weights and the MDF payout calendar before the QBR deck on Friday. Can folks chime in with must-haves? I'm thinking: marketplace launches, HW co-marketing, SI integrations, and announcement cadence alignment.
rajan: Agree. Primary ask from the field: make MDF claims predictable (monthly windows) + align payouts with marketplace listing dates.
marcus: Scorecard proposal: 40% net-new revenue, 25% joint marketing activity, 20% product integrations (SI), 15% enablement/customer references. Thoughts?
sophia: Can we cap MDF per partner tier? Lower tiers should get smaller monthly pools instead of one big annual lump. Helps forecasting.
jess: Also need blackout dates around major cloud partner launch windows — MDF workflows break if approvals fall inside a launch sprint.
alicia: Good points. Thinking flexible tiers A/B/C with monthly buckets (rough): A: $30k/mo, B: $10k/mo, C: $2k/mo. Should we present that range in the QBR as a strawman?
rajan: Those A numbers feel high. Suggest A: $20k/mo + an on-demand cofund pot for marquee launches.
marcus: Add a bonus multiplier for partners that complete both marketplace listing + SI integration in the same quarter (e.g., 1.25x payout).
sophia: Action list so we don't lose momentum: 1) finalize weights, 2) confirm monthly caps by tier, 3) draft announcement cadence matrix (press + marketplace + partner comms) with approval owners. Who volunteers?
jess: I can draft the cadence matrix. ETA Wed EOD. I'll include approval steps and expected TAT.
alicia: Thanks Jess. I'll update scorecard weights based on input and post the final table Thu AM. Can calendar-bot schedule a 30m sync Thu 10:00 to review?
calendar-bot: Event created: "Partner MDF & QBR sync" Thu 10:00 - 10:30 — invites sent to alicia, rajan, marcus, sophia, jess.
rajan: For the QBR slide deck we need a 1-pager: scorecard table, tier caps, MDF calendar, announcement cadence. Anyone have a prior one we can adapt?
marcus: Dropping an example from last SI program: https://drive.google.com/example — see tab 'bonus structure' and 'payment cadence'.
sophia: We should flag product/legal for co-marketing SLA — approval delays were the main blocker last quarter. If approvals take >5 business days payouts get delayed.
alicia: Agreed. We'll loop in legal after numbers are locked. For planning assume 5 business day approval TAT and include that in the matrix.
jess: :thumbsup: I'll add an 'approval TAT' column and owner for each cadence row.
alicia: Final ask — if anyone objects to the proposed weights, post them here by Wed 12:00 PT. If silent, I'll lock the values for the QBR deck.
rajan: Will review and post any tweaks by Wed morning.
marcus: Sounds good. Thanks everyone — this is actionable.
